item.title: NIST director nominee commits to support AI standards-setting, manufacturing
item.description: Arvind Raman told lawmakers that it is “vitally important” that the U.S. lead in global standards-setting so that the country’s values are entrenched in AI development.

item.title: DOD names James “Aaron” Bishop to serve as CISO
item.description: Bishop previously served as CISO for the Air Force and as the CISO and VP at Science Applications International Corporation before that.

item.title: FBI is probing ‘suspicious’ breach into bureau networks
item.description: Initial reporting tied the incident to the FBI’s wiretap systems, which are used to lawfully surveil suspected criminals and spies.

item.title: Private sector, former military leaders urge Congress intervene in Pentagon-Anthropic dispute
item.description: Over 30 former military officers and individuals working in tech sent a letter to congressional leadership expressing concern over the Pentagon-Anthropic dispute and asking for lawmakers to take action to reign in executive power and set AI guardrails.

item.title: Lawmakers raise questions about security of health data shared with AI tools
item.description: “I do think there's some consumer safeguards that should be implemented,” Sen. Bill Cassidy, R-La., said about the way AI firms may apply users’ healthcare data.

item.title: Mullin’s appointment to lead DHS raises questions about future of CISA
item.description: Following months of turmoil, Kristi Noem’s exit leaves uncertainty around DHS’s cyber mission, after CISA faced hefty workforce cuts and still contends with a leadership vacuum.

item.title: Robotics ethicist calls for stronger US guardrails as automation accelerates
item.description: Automation is advancing while the rules are not, the research lead for robotics, ethics and society at the Robotics and AI Institute warned.

item.title: Tech bills of the week: quantum computing research; AI workforce development; and more
item.description: Lawmakers introduced measures this week to criminalize AI-generated impersonation, modernize NOAA’s weather radio system and create a nationwide network of cloud-enabled laboratories.

item.title: Senators call on agencies to capture AI’s workforce impact
item.description: A bipartisan group of senators are asking the Department of Labor, Bureau of Labor Statistics and the Census Bureau to update their national surveys to better understand artificial intelligence’s impacts in the culture and workforce.

item.title: Trump’s new cyber strategy details more offensive response to cyber threats
item.description: “Unlike other Administrations, the Trump Administration will not tinker at the edges and apply partial measures and ambiguous strategies that neglect the growing number and severity of cyber threats,” the strategy said.
